_comment: The reward line of a title cosmetic (icon "title:<id>"): the crowned red ribbon's middle, its gold crown over the gold-rimmed band. The whole ribbon is 690x160; in a 46-unit reward box it was a 46x11 sliver. The middle keeps the two things that say 'a title' at 46 -- the crown and the banner's red -- and its ends fade out over 9 units instead of stopping square. Keyed off the sheet's navy (8, 18, 27). Drawn down to 46, 52 and 64; never up.
